candidates.name: Ably Realtime Ltd.
candidates.description: Both provide real-time infrastructure for developers to build collaborative, live-updating features.
candidates.rationale: Same B2B real-time developer infrastructure category; both sell live collaboration and messaging primitives to product teams.

candidates.name: PubNub
candidates.description: Both offer real-time communication APIs and pub/sub services to enable live synchronization in apps.
candidates.rationale: Same real-time app infrastructure category; both sell APIs for live synchronization and collaboration features to product teams.

candidates.name: convex.dev
candidates.description: Both provide reactive backend infrastructure that automatically updates the UI when data changes.
candidates.rationale: Different product category: Convex is reactive backend infrastructure, while Liveblocks provides realtime collaboration primitives.

candidates.name: Supabase, Inc.
candidates.description: Both offer backend-as-a-service tools with real-time capabilities for synchronizing application state.
candidates.rationale: Supabase is a backend/database platform, not a collaboration-UI primitives vendor like Liveblocks; different primary buyer and use case.

candidates.name: PartyKit, Inc.
candidates.description: Both focus on enabling developers to turn applications into real-time multiplayer experiences.
candidates.rationale: Both are developer platforms for real-time collaborative/multiplayer app infrastructure, targeting similar product teams and buyers.

candidates.name: Yjs Shared Editing
candidates.description: Both provide the core Conflict-free Replicated Data Type (CRDT) logic necessary for shared editing.
candidates.rationale: Same collaborative editing infrastructure category: CRDT/shared editing primitives for product teams, overlapping buyers and use cases.

candidates.name: Automerge 2
candidates.description: Both provide synchronization frameworks to enable collaborative data structures across different clients.
candidates.rationale: Both are collaboration infrastructure vendors for realtime shared state and sync in product apps, targeting similar developer buyers.

candidates.name: Replicache
candidates.description: Both specialize in low-latency state synchronization and conflict resolution for collaborative software.
candidates.rationale: Same collaborative software infrastructure category: low-latency sync and conflict resolution for app teams.

candidates.name: Socket
candidates.description: Both enable real-time, bidirectional communication between clients and servers for live features.
candidates.rationale: Both sell developer infrastructure for real-time in-app experiences; overlapping buyer persona (product/engineering teams) and use cases, though Socket.IO is lower-level transport.

candidates.name: Deepstream
candidates.description: Both provide a real-time data synchronization layer for building collaborative web applications.
candidates.rationale: Same real-time collaboration infrastructure category for web apps; similar buyer persona and use case.
